title: This Owl Catches Mice It Can't See, Using Only Its Ears
subject: barn owl

scenes.text: This owl catches mice in total darkness. It never sees them.
Its ears sit at different heights on its head. One is higher than the other.
A sound from above reaches the higher ear a touch louder, and the owl compares the timing between both ears.
That lets it pinpoint a sound to within about one and a half degrees, up and down and left and right.
So a mouse rustling under snow or grass is already found before the owl strikes.
It hunts with its ears, and the dark is no problem at all.

description:
Barn owls catch mice in total darkness using only sound.
Asymmetric ears let them pinpoint a noise to within about 1.5 degrees.
Could you find a sound that precisely with your eyes closed?
first_comment: Close your eyes and point at a sound. Could you get within two degrees?
